rationale: PO-4413 is a SERVICES PO, so the absence of a goods receipt is expected and not a defect (clause 1). Invoice line matches the PO exactly (1 EACH @ $7,500.00, zero price variance under clause 3), recomputed tax at the vendor's 7.5% rate equals the supplier's $562.50 (clause 5), and there are no prior invoices or open credit memos (clauses 8, 9).
